baseline_semantics: Matches recorded Thor vendor source; not a new comparison to untouched upstream arithmetic.
checkout_instructions: Clone the public repository into a NEW destination with GIT_LFS_SKIP_SMUDGE=1.
Check out source.revision detached; verify exact git rev-parse HEAD before applying anything.
If patch is present, verify its SHA256 and use git apply --check followed by git apply.
Verify every expected_patched_files SHA256. Existing vendor directories must remain untouched.
